search_text: published ZDI-10-084 ZDI-CAN-573 HP OpenView NNM getnnmdata.exe CGI Invalid MaxAge Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-05-11 CVE-2010-1553 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-1553 10.0 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['OpenView Network Node Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Network Node Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getnnmdata.exe CGI. If this CGI is requested with an invalid MaxAge parameter a sprintf() call is made to log the error. However, no length check is performed on the variable contents before copying in to a fixed-length stack buffer. This can be leveraged by remote attackers to execute arbitrary code under the context of the webserver process. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://h20000.www2.hp.com/bizsupport/TechSupport/Document.jsp?objectID=c02153379 ['2009-10-21 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2010-05-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Anonymous https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-10-084/
